title: Road traffic counts (hourly) - counters near monitoring stations
summary: Hourly vehicle counts per road counter (counter_id, ts_local, vehicles), owned by the Mobility Office and described in the catalog as counters located near the city's monitoring stations. Catalog lists about 15 million rows and temporal coverage from 2021-01-01 with no end date. A wiki page documents that the counters were replaced on 2024-03-18 and that counting changed from per-direction to both-directions-combined, which the catalog does not mention. No counter-to-station mapping was found, so the link to air-quality readings is not established.

schema.notes: Catalog columns only. No station, location, distance, direction or vehicle-class field is documented. Direction was recorded before 2024-03-18 per wiki counter_replacement_2024 but is not a column in the catalog.

spatial.code_system: counter_id (free-text road counter code); no geography field
spatial.notes: Catalog says counters are near monitoring stations; no mapping from counter_id to station or coordinates is documented. Area of the counters is not stated in the catalog entry beyond the client's city context.

ownership.steward: named steward in catalog entry (not recorded here)

licence.name: internal
licence.evidence: catalog entry internal.traffic.hourly_counts: classification 'internal', contains_pii false

documentation_excerpts: Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations. (catalog traffic.hourly_counts, description)

On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced. Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined. Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. The catalog entry for traffic.hourly_counts has no note about this. (wiki counter_replacement_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02)

Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30 ... The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01; relevant to station linkage, not to counters)
quality_notes: Catalog vs wiki disagreement: the catalog entry has no note on the 2024-03-18 counter replacement and direction change; wiki counter_replacement_2024 (2024-04-02) says the catalog has no note. Catalog export 2026-10-14 still has no note.

Break in series: counts before 2024-03-18 are per direction and after are both directions combined. Naive comparison across the break is invalid; an adjustment or a split at that date is needed. The adjustment factor is not documented.
Direction is not a column in the catalog, so the pre-2024 per-direction counts cannot be identified from the documented schema.

No counter-to-station mapping, coordinates or distance is documented. The claim 'near monitoring stations' rests only on the catalog description. Proximity to the stations cannot be verified from metadata.

ts_local is local time with no documented time zone or daylight-saving handling. Autumn DST repeats hours and spring DST skips them; alignment with UTC air-quality data (airq.station_readings ts_utc) needs an explicit conversion rule.
Vehicle class definition (all vehicles vs. light/heavy) is not documented, and the unit is stated only as 'vehicles'.
Catalog coverage starts 2021-01-01, which is earlier than the production window; the actual first date with data was not verified (no sample possible).
Not tested: no access probe was made. The source is warehouse_sql behind a request to the Mobility Office, so reachability and access approval are unknown.

provenance.claim: Catalog fields: description, owner (Mobility Office), temporal_coverage 2021-01-01 to open, refresh hourly, last_refreshed 2026-10-12, row_count_approx 15,000,000, three columns, access warehouse_sql with request to Mobility Office
Counters replaced 2024-03-18; per-direction before, both directions combined after; catalog has no note
No counter-to-station mapping is documented; station network page covers only station VR-03 switch-off and reporting from 2023-01-01
provenance.evidence: search_internal_catalog 'road counter locations mapping to air quality monitoring stations'; read_wiki_page station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01)
